name: motion-stagger-follow
title: Stagger Follow
description: Bốn viên thuốc cùng trượt 165 px, mỗi lớp trễ 55 ms và nhạt dần, như một dòng chảy.

moworks.author: moworks

options.backAt: s after the start to return (null, 0.55 s power2.in)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Four pills (50×18) in rows: x 0 → 165 px (demo 190) in 900 ms power2.out each, 55 ms apart; row opacities 1 / 0.72 / 0.5 / 0.32. Return: same stagger, 550 ms power2.in back to the start. Params: duration (0.9 s) · x (165 px) · stagger (55 ms) · ease (power2.out).
